request_outcomes.question: Can I pay with an HSA card?
request_outcomes.answer: Yes, we accept Health Savings Account (HSA) cards as a form of payment, due at the time of service.

citations.chunk_text:
Question: When is payment due, and what payment methods do you accept?
Answer: Payment is due at the time of service. We accept cash, major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) / Health Savings Account (HSA) cards.

assistant_message.content:
Thanks for reaching out! Yes, we do accept Health Savings Account (HSA) cards as a form of payment, and payment is due at the time of service.

As for your question about bringing along a guide dog, I don't have that information in our knowledge base right now. I've forwarded it to our staff, who will follow up with you. In the meantime, feel free to ask if there's anything else I can help with!
